highlights.title: Live Updates: Scale of Flood Disaster Grows as Nepal Doubles Estimate of Missing
highlights.summary: A spokeswoman for the Nepali disaster relief agency said the tally grew to 1,900 after some 900 people were reported missing from hydropower projects. Rescue efforts were complicated by fears of new flooding.

highlights.title: Trump anuncia acordo que garante aos EUA controle de mais de 65 bilhões de barris de petróleo em reservas da Venezuela
highlights.summary:
Tanques com o logo da PDVSA em refinaria em Curaçao
Andres Martinez Casares/Reuters
O presidente dos EUA, Donal Trump, anunciou nesta sexta-feira (28) um acordo que garante aos EUA o controle de reservas de petróleo da Venezuela equivalentes a 65 bilhões de barris.
